real_defects.issue: Amounts parsed with replace(/[$,£€\s]/g,''), so a decimal comma '29,99' read as 2999 (100x MRR) and '1.234,56' as 1.23; interval count '3 months', 0 or -3 fell back to 1 (quarterly price counted at 3x MRR). Fixed: toAmount reads the comma by shape, bad interval count skipped with a reason; tests in csv.test.mjs.
parseNumber stripped every comma (and €), so '€29,99' read as 2999 and '1.234,56' as 1.23456. Fixed the same way; test in calc.test.mjs.

--price stripped every comma, so 'oak=420,50' read as $42,050/MBF, and 'oak=' read as $0. Landed on main (PR #17935) while this run was open; check_money_comma.py failed this PR's CI on it on its first run. Fixed: thousands commas only, empty refused (exit 2); tests in cli.test.mjs.
